ops.title: CCI Gatekeeper consent and three idle-only MCP reconnect scope
ops.body: Root relayed new user authorization: the user tapped Gatekeeper consent. Clear quarantine only on verified new CCI binaries before their first execution, then verify startup. This consent does not authorize a syspolicy restart. Reconnect only plugin:cc-inbox:cci in alewife, basketstar and sole, once per target and only while IDLE, preserving the agent, TTY, supervisor and supported MCP command. No direct PID kills or reconnect-all. Root retains actual runtime-control/reconnect custody unless explicitly transferred; this source lane has executed none of these actions. Authorization is not adoption proof: new loaded image, surviving session and startup/delivery evidence are still required. All other session protections remain.
